An '''egg''' is a base [[ingredient]] with no [[intrinsic]]. All three egg colors (white, blue and brown) are accepted in every recipe. Eggs are fried into [[Fried Egg|fried egg]]s and are needed for [[dough]], [[French Toast|French toast]], [[latke]]s, [[gnocchi]], [[cake]] and many other dishes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/dough.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

An egg and 2 [[flour]] make 4 [[dough]], the cheapest way to make dough. Eggs are also used in [[French Toast|French toast]], [[Honied French Toast|honied French toast]], [[Sweet Berry Toast|sweet berry toast]], [[gimmari]], [[Pad Thai]], [[Kontomire-Dandelion Stew]], [[latke]]s, [[gnocchi]], [[cake]] and [[Ramen Stock|ramen stock]].

The [[Farmer]] sells fertilized eggs that hatch into chickens; see [[Livestock]].
